Veteran Services
The staff of the Jerauld County Veterans Service Office is available to assist veterans and their families in obtaining all benefits and services available to them including:
Enrollment for VA Healthcare
Veterans and Widows Pension
Compensation for service-connected disabilities
Education and on-the-job training
Vocational Rehabilitation
Replacement of a lost discharge (DD-214)
VA Loan Guaranty Certificate
Burial benefits and grave marker application
National Cemetery information
Obtaining service medals and award.
